summary: SB Drive Access driver profile (photo + bio + trainings) admin flow + booking enrichment + /course WhatsApp button removal — fully tested. Backend 7/7 pytest passing. Frontend admin upload + save + reload persistence verified; user confirmation 'certified-driver-card' displays photo/name/bio/training chips; /course no longer has big 'Réserver via WhatsApp' button while the small per-vehicle WhatsApp badge is still present.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend PUT /access/admin/drivers/{id}/profile correctly trims bio to 600 chars, dedupes/strips blanks in trainings, caps trainings to 12 — good defensive validation.
GET /access/admin/drivers now selectively projects access_photo/bio/trainings — small payload increase but acceptable.

_build_and_store_booking enriches booking with matched_driver_photo/bio/trainings using a single .find_one — fine for Phase 1; future improvement: random sampling or distance-based matching of certified drivers (currently always returns the first certified driver due to Mongo natural order).

RideChoosePage.js: confirmed the big 'Réserver via WhatsApp' CTA was removed from renderCta; only the per-vehicle whatsapp badge remains and acts as a button calling openWhatsApp (whatsapp:// scheme on mobile, wa.me on desktop) — UX intent preserved.

AdminAccess Drivers component uploads via accessAPI.uploadImage and stores the returned relative URL (/api/uploads/{id}); the user-side confirmation displays it as — same relative URL works because frontend axios baseURL is REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
Minor warning: pytest emitted PytestReturnNotNoneWarning on test_upload_image_returns_relative_url (returns a value). Not a functional issue but cosmetic in tests.
Empty body PUT correctly returns 400 with French error 'Aucun champ à mettre à jour' — good.
seed_data_creation: Driver sim_driver_48d7ee09 (Ahmed Diallo) left certified with access_bio='Chauffeur formé au transport adapté (iter275-UI)', access_trainings=['Langue des signes','Aide PMR'], and access_photo set to a tiny 1x1 PNG at /api/uploads/dd58f201320140759ea121815cffc94c. Pytest itself also writes a transient bio variant during the run but final UI run leaves the values above. As requested in problem statement, this is acceptable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 user stories of iter 275 verified working end-to-end. Backend pytest: /app/backend/tests/test_iter275_access_driver_profile.py (7 tests, 7 passed). Frontend: admin /admin/access > 'Chauffeurs Access' tab successfully opens inline editor (access-driver-edit-{id}), uploads photo via access-driver-photo-input-{id} (saves relative /api/uploads/{id}), saves bio + trainings, persists after reload showing chips and circular photo bubble. User /access > rebook-btn-{id} reaches /access confirmation screen ('Étape 5 sur 5') showing certified-driver-card with photo + 'Ahmed Diallo · Certifié Access' + bio + training chips. /course no longer renders ride-choose-whatsapp-btn; the per-vehicle WhatsApp badge (e.g. vehicle-whatsapp-standard, vehicle-whatsapp-moto) is still present and clickable.
